description: Make a spaced repetition schedule for a topic: review dates at expanding intervals from the day you first studied it, with any date on or after the exam marked to skip. Example prompt: "When should I review what I learned today for my exam on 2026-11-30?"

first_study_date.description: The day you first studied it. Defaults to today.

intervals_days.description: Days after the first study to review.

name: make_spaced_repetition_schedule
title: Make a spaced repetition schedule
